thread:
Nina: Heads-up — Prospect SwapFlow wants a POC to swap out CompetitorY for Redwood. Main asks: request/response parity, billing deltas, and answers for their infosec questionnaire. POC window starts next Wed. Can SE + Security squad chime in?
Omar: I'm available. Key technical gaps we've seen: streaming token chunks vs full-response, stop-seq semantics, and multipart function-calling differences. We should offer a small adapter + smoke harness.
Ravi: For the billing question, they assume identical token accounting to CompetitorY. Note: our tokenizer and their tokenizer differ a bit; token counts won't match exactly. We should document expected token delta and provide a sample calculator.
Sienna: Security note: they'll ask SOC2 scope, data lifecycle (retention, deletion API), encryption at rest (CMEK), and access controls. Also want to know if we support dedicated VPC/private deploy for PII workloads.
Nina: Good. Can we propose a 2-week POC: week1 integration + parity tests, week2 smoke/perf and handoff? Need a short runbook to hand them.
Omar: I'll draft a runbook with endpoints and a mapping example. Example shim mapping:
```
Client -> POST /v1/generate
{ "prompt": "...", "max_tokens": 150, "stop": ["\n\n"] }
Translate -> POST /v1/completions
{ "input": prompt, "length": max_tokens, "eos_tokens": stop }
Add header: X-Compat-Client: competitor-y
```
This preserves stop tokens and lets us centralize token counting.
Ravi: I'll create a quick token-diff spreadsheet and include examples for 10 sample prompts so they can see the delta. Also will include our unit costs and a reserved-capacity scenario (100M tokens/mo).
Sienna: For the infosec questionnaire, I'll prepare draft answers and include: SOC2 status (in scope), encryption (AES-256 + CMEK), KMS options (AWS/GCP/Azure), audit logs retention (90 days, longer on request), private deploy option, pen-test windows, and SIEM integrations (syslog/forwarder).
Nina: Thanks. Do we have an automated parity harness we can hand over? Something that runs a prompt set and reports semantic diffs + token counts?
Omar: We have an internal tool 'shim-smoke' that runs batches and compares normalized responses. I'll package a docker image + README. It does whitespace normalization, canonical JSON compare, and computes a semantic similarity score (cosine on embeddings).
Ravi: Pricing quick answers: hosted list unit cost $0.005 / 1k tokens. Committed 12mo reserved: ~18-25% off depending on commit. SLA addon extra. I'll sketch a starter quote and ask finance to formalize.
Sienna: Action items recap:
- Omar: runbook + shim mapping + dockerized shim-smoke -> due Fri 10:00
- Sienna: draft infosec questionnaire answers -> due Mon EOD
- Ravi: token-delta spreadsheet + preliminary pricing for 100M tokens/mo -> due Mon 12:00
- Nina: assemble POC timeline and NDA + schedule kickoff -> due Mon EOD
security-bot: Note: please include contact for pen-test coordination (sec-eng@redwood.com) and check SOC2 attestation link in the doc.
deploy-bot: Built image shim-smoke:20240202 -> pushed to staging registry.
Nina: Nice. Omar, please attach the 20-30 prompt seed set (mix of edge cases + typical). We should show streaming vs non-streaming diffs for a few samples.
Omar: Will do. I'll include examples for stop-token edge cases and multipart function-call traces.
Ravi: Also add a short section in the runbook about how we bill streaming vs chunked streaming (we bill per token emitted, not per chunk). Important to call out.
Sienna: I'll also note data residency constraints and our Private deployment lead time (~3-4 weeks depending on infra).
Nina: Great — looks like we're aligned. I'll send a kickoff note to SwapFlow and attach the NDA template. Ping me for approvals.
